description: CSS injection via the style attribute on span/pre (HIGH-1): position overlays, background:url() exfiltration, expression()/behavior/-moz-binding script vectors, comment-hidden declarations. The sanitizer allow-lists the style attribute (KaTeX needs layout properties) but filters every declaration to a strict safe-property allow-list, so dangerous capabilities are stripped while safe layout properties survive. Structural safety: no style attribute may contain dangerous CSS capabilities (position, background:url, expression, behavior, -moz-binding, z-index, external URLs). Safe declarations (color, vertical-align) survive.
